mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns on average.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 6.0% signals economic distress and risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) relative to their 12-month averages indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline from their 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index 2017=100) indicates an economic contraction phase, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) level above 130,000 thousand persons indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual rate > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) combined with a federal funds rate at or below 0.1% (FEDFUNDS) indicates delayed monetary policy response to inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual rate > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 600.0 thousand units indicate a contraction in the residential construction sector, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns during early economic downturns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 600.0.
